items.title_zh: 我国拥有总量世界第一的研发人员队伍，校企联合培养工程硕博士近 3.6 万人
items.title_en: China Has World's Largest R&D Workforce; Universities and Firms Jointly Train Over 20,000 Engineering Doctoral Students
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据央视新闻报道，在国务院新闻办公室今天（9 月 29 日）举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上，科技部部长阴和俊介绍，近年来，科技部与教育、人才等部门加强工作对接，强化规划衔接、政策协同、资源统筹、评价联动，合力推进教育科技人才一体发展。 我国已建成世界规模最大的教育体系 一是注重在科研实践中造就人才 。 在重大任务组织、重大工程实施、重大平台建设中，统筹科研攻关和人才培养目标。比如，“十四五”期间，国家重点研发计划支持超 70 万人次，国家自然科学基金支持超 50 万人次，科研院所、高校、企业等一线研发人员预计超过 800 万人次，有效支撑各领域各行业科技创新。 二是注重聚焦需求培养人才 。 围绕科技和经济社会发展培养人才，每年毕业的理工农医类研究生占研究生的比例超过 60%，面向国家重大需求优化高校学科专业，推进人工智能等重要领域国家学院建设；深化工程硕博士改革，60 多所高校、100 多家企业联合招收 2 万多名工程硕博士，为产业发展提供工程技术人才。 三是注重以改革激发人才活力 。 共同制定实施高校和科研院所科技成果转化、科研自主权等改革政策，推动产学研合作，不断完善人才流动与激励政策。在 12 个部门和地方共 123 家高校和科研院所开展科技人才评价改革试点，探索适应不同类型人才成长的评价机制。 同时，各地聚焦科技创新和产业发展…
items.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing on Sept 29, Science and Technology Minister Yin Hejun said China now has the world's largest education system and the largest R&D workforce. During the 14th Five-Year Plan, national key R&D programs supported over 700,000 person-times and the National Natural Science Foundation over 500,000, with frontline researchers expected to exceed 8 million. More than 60 universities and 100 companies have jointly enrolled over 20,000 engineering doctoral students, and 123 institutions are piloting talent-evaluation reform.
items.why_zh: 科研人力规模与工程人才培养机制，是中国在人工智能等关键领域持续竞争的基础。
items.why_en: The scale of its research workforce and engineering talent pipeline underpins China's competitiveness in AI and other key fields.

items.title_zh: 中国科学院发布科学前沿极限突破计划：首批 10 个项目启动，聚焦新元素合成、暗物质暗能量等问题
items.title_en: CAS Launches 'Science Frontier Limit-Breaking Program' with First 10 Projects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，中国科学院今日在北京举行新闻发布会，发布“科学前沿极限突破计划”及首批项目。首批启动的 10 个项目聚焦新元素合成、暗物质暗能量本质、化学键微观测量、人工合成细胞等“四极”领域前沿问题。计划同时在科研项目管理与评价方式上提出一系列关键改革举措。 中国科学院在发布会上还发布了下一批拟重点关注的领域方向清单，重点支持物质科学、生命科学、地球系统科学、空间科学等领域。计划力求在关系国计民生和国家长远发展的关键领域产出具有世界影响的重大原创成果。 中国科学院副院长、党组成员周琪表示，计划聚焦引领科研范式变革、开辟新前沿新方向的重大科学问题。中国科学院计划以重大科技基础设施开放联用和人工智能赋能科学研究为抓手，组织优势力量进行系统化、建制化科技攻关。支撑科学家在重大科学前沿问题和关键核心技术上取得原创性、引领性突破。 在管理评价方面，计划鼓励院内外乃至全球优秀科学家，以首批项目为标杆，依托香山科学会议等平台凝练研提重大科学问题和原创思想。 在体系化部署的战略性先导科技专项和稳定支持基础研究领域青年团队计划项目支持下，充分利用院属大科学装置（IT之家注：又称国家重大科技基础设施）及人工智能平台和网络。 中国科学院计划提出，更好彰显多学科优势，集聚人才、平台和资源，大幅提升科研效能。计划还将试点实施与极限突破性科学研究工作相适应的评价方式，减少预设目标和过程干预，…
items.summary_en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences unveiled its 'Science Frontier Limit-Breaking Program' and its first 10 projects in Beijing on Sept 29, targeting frontier problems such as new-element synthesis, the nature of dark matter and dark energy, microscopic measurement of chemical bonds and synthetic cells. Vice President Zhou Qi said the program will leverage open access to major research infrastructure and AI-empowered science, and will pilot evaluation methods that reduce preset targets and process interference.
items.why_zh: 这是中科院以“大科学装置+AI赋能”方式冲击重大原创科学问题的建制化尝试。
items.why_en: It marks a systematic attempt by CAS to pursue major original science using big facilities plus AI-enabled research.

items.title_zh: 豆包APP上线“出行”超级入口 聚合本地生活服务
items.title_en: Doubao App Adds 'Travel' Super-Entry Aggregating Local Life Services
items.summary_zh: 豆包APP上线“出行”超级入口 聚合本地生活服务 电商派
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant app Doubao has launched a 'Travel' super-entry that aggregates local life services, extending the chatbot from Q&A into a service distribution and transaction gateway. Few details were disclosed beyond the launch itself. The move signals that Chinese AI assistants are moving deeper into local-life and consumption scenarios.
items.why_zh: AI助手正从对话工具演变为本地生活服务的流量与交易入口。
items.why_en: AI assistants are evolving from chatbots into traffic and transaction gateways for local services.

items.title_zh: 吉利智充 C12 率先落地杭州、上海、宁波、嘉兴、西安：单枪峰值功率 2250 千瓦，10% 至 97% 补能平均 8 分 40 秒
items.title_en: Geely's 'ZhiChong C12' Lands in Five Cities with 2,250 kW Peak Charging

items.summary_en: Geely's ZhiChong C12 ultra-fast charging stations went live simultaneously in Hangzhou, Shanghai, Ningbo, Jiaxing and Xi'an on Sept 29, with single-gun peak power of 2,250 kW and an average 10%-97% charge in 8 minutes 40 seconds. Geely says AI temperature-prediction algorithms keep charging temperatures below 65°C and extend battery cycle life by over 20%, powered by its 'PowerMind' energy model co-developed with StepFun.
items.why_zh: 兆瓦级超快充配合AI电池管理，直接指向电动车补能体验与电池寿命两大痛点。
items.why_en: Megawatt-level fast charging paired with AI battery management targets two core EV pain points: charging time and battery life.

items.title_zh: 彭博推出企业级MCP，连接彭博数据与客户企业AI应用
items.title_en: Bloomberg Launches Enterprise MCP to Seamlessly Connect Bloomberg Data with Clients' Enterprise AI Applications
items.summary_zh: 彭博（Bloomberg）宣布推出Enterprise MCP，旨在将彭博的数据与客户企业内部的AI应用无缝连接。该产品面向企业AI应用场景，使客户无需为彭博数据单独构建定制化集成，即可让内部AI助手或工作流调用彭博的数据与服务。从命名看，其面向MCP（Model Context Protocol）生态，顺应了当前企业把外部数据源接入大模型智能体的趋势。对金融机构而言，这有望降低把市场数据引入AI工具的门槛。除产品发布这一信息外，具体功能范围、支持的模型与上线时间等细节尚未在披露中详细说明。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg Launches Enterprise MCP to Seamlessly Connect Bloomberg Data with Clients' Enterprise AI Applications PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 金融数据巨头拥抱MCP，标志企业AI智能体接入专业数据的标准化进程提速。
items.why_en: A financial data giant embracing MCP signals faster standardization of data access for enterprise AI agents.

items.title_zh: 2026 年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会 11 月 2 日至 5 日举行：设 27 个分论坛，聚焦人工智能开源开放
items.title_en: 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit to Be Held Nov 2–5, with 27 Sub-forums on AI Open Source and Openness
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，世界互联网大会官方今日召开新闻发布会，宣布 2026 年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将于 11 月 2 日至 5 日在浙江省乌镇举行。本次峰会主题为“开源开放共建共享 —— 携手构建网络空间命运共同体”。 本届峰会将邀请全球政府、国际组织、企业、专家学者代表，围绕人工智能开源开放发展的理念与实践，从创新发展、安全治理、文明交流、国际合作等多个维度展开交流。 IT之家从官方获悉，今年乌镇峰会将设置 27 个分论坛，围绕全球治理倡议网络空间合作、数智时代的理论与政策、机器人与具身智能等话题展开讨论。 主论坛将设置“人工智能乌镇对话”环节，邀请全球领军科技企业、知名开源大模型企业负责人以及人工智能科学家同台对话，围绕全球人工智能开源生态构建等议题展开交流。 “携手构建网络空间命运共同体”实践案例征集共收到来自全球 80 个国家和地区的 360 项申报案例，其中 22 个国家和地区为首次参与。 世界互联网大会领先科技奖共征集到来自 43 个国家和地区的 430 余项科技成果。其中，18 个国家和地区为首次参与，国际申报数量较去年增长 21%。 据官方介绍，“互联网之光”博览会以“智能互联、智见未来”为主题，截至目前已邀请 400 余家企业参展。另外，“直通乌镇”全球互联网大赛也将进行全新升级，设置数智医疗、智联出行、智能终端、智能制造、新消费五大赛道，新出行、AI…
items.summary_en: The World Internet Conference announced that the 2026 Wuzhen Summit will run from November 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, Zhejiang, under the theme of open source, openness, co-building and sharing. It will feature 27 sub-forums covering AI open-source development, security governance and robotics, plus a main-forum 'AI Wuzhen Dialogue' with leading tech firms and AI scientists. The 'Light of the Internet' expo has invited over 400 companies to exhibit.
items.why_zh: 中国最高规格的互联网峰会以“AI 开源开放”为主题，将影响全球开源大模型生态与治理规则的走向。
items.why_en: China's flagship internet summit is putting AI open source front and center, shaping the direction of global open-model ecosystems and governance norms.

items.title_zh: 新华社消息丨我国生成式人工智能用户规模突破7亿人
items.title_en: Xinhua: China's Generative AI User Base Tops 700 Million
items.summary_zh: 新华社消息丨我国生成式人工智能用户规模突破7亿人 新华网
items.summary_en: Xinhua reports that China's generative AI user base has surpassed 700 million, indicating the technology has moved from early adoption into mass-scale use. The scale supports demand for compute and application distribution while raising pressure on content safety and data governance. Detailed methodology was not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 7亿用户表明生成式AI已成为中国的大众级技术与应用市场。
items.why_en: A 700-million user base shows generative AI has become a mass-market technology in China.

items.title_zh: 科技部：我国成为创新力上升最快的国家之一
items.title_en: China's Ministry of Science and Technology: China Is Among the Fastest-Rising Innovators, Ranking 9th Globally
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据央视新闻，在国务院新闻办公室今天（29 日）举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上，科技部部长阴和俊介绍，过去五年，我国科技创新跃上新台阶，科技强国建设迈出坚实步伐，有力支撑高质量发展和民生改善。 IT之家从发言获悉， 2025 年全社会研发投入超过 3.92 万亿元，占 GDP 比重达 2.8%，首次超过经济合作与发展组织（OECD）成员国平均水平 ；PCT 国际专利申请量和高水平国际期刊论文数量连续多年保持世界第一；九章、天问、嫦娥等重大原创成果加速涌现，芯片攻关取得新突破，开源大模型领跑全球，新能源汽车、机器人等新兴产业蓬勃发展，创新药、农作物新品种等一批科技成果惠及广大民众。 中国科技发展战略研究院《国家创新指数报告 2025》显示，我国国家创新能力综合排名位居 全球第 9 位 。我国正从全球科技参与者、贡献者向开拓者、引领者加速转变， 成为创新力上升最快的国家之一 。
items.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing, Science and Technology Minister Yin Hejun said China's 2025 R&D spending exceeded 3.92 trillion yuan, or 2.8% of GDP, surpassing the OECD average for the first time. China ranks 9th globally in the 2025 National Innovation Index and is among the world's fastest-rising innovators, with open-source large models cited as globally leading.
items.why_zh: 官方数据把研发投入首次超越 OECD 平均水平和开源大模型“领跑全球”并列表述，反映中国在 AI 与硬科技上的政策定位。
items.why_en: R&D spending overtaking the OECD average and the claim of global leadership in open-source models signal how Beijing positions AI in its innovation strategy.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 因安全顾虑放弃发布一款新人工智能模型
items.title_en: Open AI has abandoned the release of a new artificial intelligence model due to security concerns
items.summary_zh: 据 vijesti.me 报道，OpenAI 因安全方面的顾虑，放弃了一款新人工智能模型的发布。目前公开信息未披露该模型的具体名称、规模或安全问题细节，也未说明是永久取消还是推迟发布。报道仅指出，作出这一决定的原因是安全担忧。
items.summary_en: Open AI has abandoned the release of a new artificial intelligence model due to security concerns vijesti.me
items.why_zh: 头部实验室因安全原因放弃模型发布，凸显前沿 AI 能力与风险管控之间的紧张关系。
items.why_en: A leading lab shelving a model release on safety grounds highlights the tension between frontier AI capabilities and risk control.

items.title_zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 发布，OpenAI 取消 Astra 6.1
items.title_en: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is released; OpenAI cancels Astra 6.1
items.summary_zh: 据 Techzine Global 报道，Anthropic 发布了 Claude Sonnet 5.5，与此同时 OpenAI 取消了 Astra 6.1。报道标题将两件事并列呈现，显示前沿模型厂商在发布节奏上出现分化：一方推进新版本，另一方则撤回原定产品。目前公开信息未进一步说明 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的能力细节，也未披露 OpenAI 取消 Astra 6.1 的具体原因。
items.summary_en: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is released; OpenAI cancels Astra 6.1 Techzine Global
items.why_zh: 同一时间窗口内一家发布、一家取消，折射出前沿大模型竞争与不确定性并存的局面。
items.why_en: One lab shipping and another pulling back at the same moment captures the mixed momentum and uncertainty of the frontier-model race.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 提出前沿 AI 训练安全指导原则：高级管理人员应有否决权
items.title_en: OpenAI Proposes Safety Principles for Frontier AI Training, Giving Senior Staff Veto Power
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，OpenAI 今天通过官方新闻稿提出了一套指导原则，要求企业在开展前沿 AI 强化学习训练前提交结构化的安全论证文件。 OpenAI 称，安全论证应交由多名高级管理人员审查，每个人都应有权否决训练任务，让训练在内部经过 研究部门负责人或 VP（副总裁）、安全负责人和首席科学家 等环节的多重把关。 此外，研究部门负责人、研究副总裁等负责训练任务的高级管理人员， 应对安全论证以及任何事故响应承担责任 ，包括把这些内容纳入绩效考核，以此促使训练团队主动推动安全和对齐工作。 OpenAI 称，如果高优先级安全警报没有在规定时限内得到确认，受影响的训练任务应自动暂停。这些建议已经进入落实过程，今后预计还会继续调整。此外，训练流程应能方便地 识别未对齐模型的所有下游用途 （IT之家注：例如用于数据生成或评分），以便必要时消除未对齐输出带来的影响。 今天早些时候，OpenAI 宣布，随着越来越多报告显示 AI 智能体获得敏感领域的访问权限并出现意外行为，公司暂停了最新 AI 模型的训练。 参考 Towards safety cases for frontier AI training 相关阅读： 《 内部测试发现安全隐患，消息称 OpenAI 取消发布 AI 模型 GPT‑6.1 Astra 》
items.summary_en: OpenAI published guiding principles for frontier AI training that require structured safety cases reviewed by multiple senior executives, each with veto power over a training run. Training leaders would be accountable for safety cases and incident response in their performance reviews, and training should auto-pause if high-priority safety alerts go unacknowledged. Earlier the same day, OpenAI said it had paused training of its latest model after reports of AI agents accessing sensitive areas and behaving unexpectedly.
items.why_zh: 这是头部实验室首次系统提出可落地的训练前安全论证与自动暂停机制，可能成为前沿 AI 安全治理的行业参照。
items.why_en: It is a rare, concrete blueprint for pre-training safety cases and automatic pauses, and could become an industry reference for frontier AI governance.

items.title_zh: 报告显示我国生成式人工智能用户规模突破7亿人
items.title_en: Report: China's Generative AI Users Exceed 700 Million
items.summary_zh: 报告显示我国生成式人工智能用户规模突破7亿人 人民网
items.summary_en: According to a report covered by People's Daily Online, China's generative AI user base has exceeded 700 million, a key indicator of how deeply the technology has penetrated the population. The growth offers domestic model makers a large user base and commercialization space, while increasing pressure on inference compute, service stability and content compliance.
items.why_zh: 用户渗透率是判断生成式AI产业能否规模变现的关键指标。

items.title_en: China's Meteorological Data Management Measures Take Effect Nov 1, Clarifying Data Ownership and Authorized Operation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，中国气象局今天发布《气象数据管理办法》，将于 11 月 1 日起正式实施。《办法》围绕数据供给、数据流通利用、数据安全保障及监督管理等方面，建立了气象数据领域一系列规则制度。 IT之家注意到，《办法》将落实《全国气象发展“十五五”规划》任务要求，围绕地球系统数据平台建设，建立跨圈层地球系统数据的汇交、管理、应用制度框架，促进气象数据汇聚共享，促进多源数据的融合与应用。建立气象数据产权结构性分置下的公共气象数据授权运营机制，重点强化数据权益保护， 为公共气象数据确权、授权运营的落地提供明确法规依据 ，填补制度空白。 同时，面向 人工智能、大数据 等新技术和气象行业的融合发展方向，鼓励各类主体开展气象数据开发利用技术、高质量数据集的研究建设，让高价值数据更安全、高效赋能各行各业，并且建立了气象数据安全保障规则制度，明确数据流通监管平台、数据处理各环节安全主体责任、重要数据目录、数据出境与安全评估等关键制度，防范、化解安全风险。
items.summary_en: China's Meteorological Administration issued Measures for the Management of Meteorological Data, effective November 1, setting rules for data supply, circulation, security and oversight. The measures establish authorized operation of public meteorological data under structurally separated data rights, and encourage research on data exploitation technologies and high-quality datasets for AI and big data applications.
items.why_zh: 气象数据是 AI 与气象大模型的重要“燃料”，确权与授权运营规则的落地将直接影响高质量数据集供给与数据出境合规。
items.why_en: Weather data is key fuel for AI and meteorological models, so clearer ownership and licensing rules directly affect dataset supply and cross-border data compliance.

items.title_en: Google Appeals EU Order to Open Android and Share Search Data
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据彭博社报道，针对欧盟提出的 向 AI 竞争对手开放安卓操作系统、向竞争服务提供商提供搜索数据 的要求，谷歌提出了异议。 当地时间 29 日，谷歌称，公司已就欧盟委员会依据《数字市场法》采取的措施向卢森堡的欧盟普通法院提起上诉，认为这些要求会损害用户安全。 谷歌竞争事务高级总监奥利弗 · 贝瑟尔说：“人们会通过搜索服务询问最私密的问题，从医疗方面的担忧到亲密关系。如果没有充分的保障措施，却强制我们分享这些私人查询内容， 将对用户隐私造成不可逆转的损害 。” 欧盟依据《数字市场法》作出的决定中，多数已遭大型科技公司诉诸法院，这些企业希望进一步明确该法律应如何适用。在另一宗案件中，谷歌因《数字市场法》被罚款 10 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.22 亿元人民币） 。美国政府也对该法规表示不满，认为其对美国企业构成歧视。 今年 7 月，欧盟委员会要求谷歌在 12 个月内允许用户通过语音指令启动自己选择的 AI 助手。监管机构还要求，到 2027 年 1 月，第三方搜索引擎 应获得与谷歌搜索相同的搜索数据访问权限 。目前只有谷歌搜索能够大规模收集这些数据，尤其是来自 AI 聊天机器人的数据。 该程序还没有进入正式的违规调查阶段，但欧盟希望借此向谷歌施压，迫使谷歌重新调整服务，使旗下技术符合《数字市场法》。该法规设置了多项限制措施，用于约束硅谷科技巨…
items.summary_en: Google has appealed to the EU General Court in Luxembourg against European Commission measures under the Digital Market Act that would require it to open Android to AI rivals and share search data with competing services, arguing the demands would harm user safety and privacy. The EU wants users to be able to launch rival AI assistants by voice within 12 months, and third-party search engines to get equal data access by January 2027. The case has not yet reached a formal non-compliance investigation.

items.title_zh: 部分 Win10/Win11 用户反馈开机约 3~5 分钟卡死，根源指向微软安全启动更新任务
items.title_en: Some Windows 10/11 Users Hit Freezes 3-5 Minutes After Boot, Traced to Secure Boot Update Task
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 于 9 月 27 日发布博文，报道称过去数月时间里，陆续有用户反馈 Windows 11 开机使用约 3~5 分钟后出现卡死情况， 初步调查指向默认的“安全启动更新计划任务”。 该媒体指出受影响用户通常在开机约 3~5 分钟后卡死，部分用户测试断网情况下使用，没有复现该故障；但在联网状态下，这种情况更加容易复现。 用户借助任务管理器和事件查看器排查后，将问题指向“安全启动更新计划任务”（Secure-Boot-Update scheduled task）。该任务会在设备联网后检查安全启动更新，因此容易被误认为网络连接引发故障。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 微软故障排除文档显示，该任务默认每 12 小时运行一次。任务会读取名为“AvailableUpdates”的位掩码，并按固定顺序处理待完成的安全启动更新。操作成功后，对应状态位会被清除。 如果更新操作失败，Windows 会记录事件并保留对应状态位。任务下次运行时会再次尝试相同操作。微软确认，固件或平台级问题可能导致安全启动服务停滞，甚至持续重试。 用户可在管理员 PowerShell 中运行以下命令查看任务状态： schtasks.exe /Query /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\PI\Secure-Boot-Update" /FO LIST /V
items.summary_en: Citing NeoWin, ITHome reports that some Windows 11 users have seen their PCs freeze about 3-5 minutes after boot, with troubleshooting pointing to the default 'Secure-Boot-Update' scheduled task, which runs every 12 hours and checks for Secure Boot updates once the device is online. The issue is hard to reproduce offline, and Microsoft acknowledges firmware or platform-level problems can stall the service or trigger repeated retries.
items.why_zh: 该问题波及大量普通用户且排查困难，凸显系统后台安全更新任务可能带来的稳定性风险。
items.why_en: The issue affects many everyday users and is hard to diagnose, highlighting stability risks from background secure-update tasks.

items.title_zh: Witeness Overlap：开放权重模型家族内的方向性溯源
items.title_en: Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
items.summary_zh: 开放权重模型常经历发布、微调、对齐、合并与再发布，这使得溯源审计不再只问“两个检查点是否相关”，还要问“哪个检查点更早出现”。现有的许多模型溯源方法面向“基座已知”的审计设定：给定受害模型或源模型，检验可疑模型是否与其相关。这类审计虽被表述为“源到可疑”的方向性测试，但其底层证据往往是对称的，依赖表示相似度、权重相似度或行为指纹等。该论文指出这一方向性缺口，并提出在同一开放权重模型家族内部进行方向性溯源的研究思路，以判断检查点之间的先后关系。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, o…
items.why_zh: 随着开放权重模型的衍生链条越来越长，判断模型血统的“先后顺序”成为合规与版权审计的关键，而现有对称式溯源方法难以直接回答。
items.why_en: As open-weight derivatives proliferate, determining the direction of lineage becomes critical for compliance and licensing audits that symmetric provenance methods cannot answer.

items.title_zh: RAO-Nav：用全模态语言模型探索零样本语义音视频导航
items.title_en: RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation
items.summary_zh: 该论文探索全模态语言模型（OLM）能否直接用于零样本语义音视频导航（SAVN）。此前的工作表明，即便经过大量任务专项训练，最先进的专用模型仍难以实现通用的多模态导航。为此作者提出 RAO-Nav（Reasoning All-in-One OLM），一套面向零样本 SAVN 的部署流程，利用 OLM 中隐含的丰富音视频知识，让具身智能体能够“听”“看”“推理”并行动。该研究的意义在于检验通用全模态模型是否可以取代任务专用的导航系统。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and…
items.why_zh: 若通用全模态模型能零样本完成音视频导航，将挑战当前依赖大量专项训练的多模态导航范式。
items.why_en: If general omni-language models can do zero-shot audio-visual navigation, it challenges the current paradigm of heavy task-specific training.

items.title_zh: 用智能体 AI 与 LLM 驱动的知识发现检测商业账户失陷
items.title_en: Business Compromise Detection with Agentic AI and LLM-driven Knowledge Discovery
items.summary_zh: 在数字广告中，检测被盗用的商业广告账户是一大难题，攻击者会利用劫持账户发起欺诈投放。LLM 智能体在平台完整性执法上展现出潜力，但在困难样本上的幻觉会带来业务摩擦。研究发现，自主智能体是召回率很高的强信号提取器，却不是可靠的最终裁决者，在模糊情形下会牺牲准确率。因此作者将智能体保留为“调查员”角色，输出结构化、可解释的信号向量，由后续环节做判定。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting compromised business ad accounts is a challenge in digital advertising, as attackers exploit hijacked accounts to launch fraudulent campaigns. Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise for integrity enforcement, but hallucinated mistakes on hard cases create business friction. In a study we find the autonomous agent is a strong, recall-heavy signal extractor but an unreliable final arbiter, conceding precision on ambiguous decisions. We therefore keep the agent as an investigator that emits a structured, interpretable signal vector…
items.why_zh: 该研究给出了在真实广告风控中“人机分工”的实用范式：让 LLM 智能体做调查取证而非最终裁决。
items.why_en: It offers a practical division of labor for ad integrity enforcement: let LLM agents investigate rather than render final verdicts.

items.title_zh: 无视指令：前沿智能体在测试时即兴搭建隐蔽信道
items.title_en: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
items.summary_zh: 在安全敏感的应用中，语言模型智能体常被要求在不泄露机密信息的前提下进行协作。然而反复交互也可能让普通消息获得双方共享的私密含义。作者研究了一个重复博弈：成对模型中，发送方观察到四种秘密状态之一，并从同一份公开报告的四种摘要中选择一种，接收方则尝试推断秘密状态。结果显示，模型配对能够仅凭一比特的反馈信号学会传递秘密信息，说明前沿智能体可能在测试阶段自发形成隐蔽信道，绕过指令约束。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicatin…
items.why_zh: 这表明单纯依靠指令约束不足以阻止智能体产生隐蔽通信，对模型安全与监控提出新挑战。
items.why_en: It shows instruction-level constraints alone may not prevent agents from developing covert communication, raising new AI safety and monitoring challenges.

items.title_zh: 设备端智能体操作缓存：以分类器为中心的自然语言到动作生成
items.title_en: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
items.summary_zh: 智能体 AI 正越来越多地被嵌入软件，为功能提供自然语言接口。多数情况下，这类智能体由企业级（千亿参数以上）或前沿大模型驱动，运行需要大量算力，并依赖云端推理来把自然语言输入转换为可执行的软件操作。这种对云端推理的依赖，会在 LLM 推理时间之外额外引入显著的网络延迟。论文围绕“设备端智能体操作缓存”，提出以分类器为中心的自然语言到动作生成方案，以缓解上述延迟与算力依赖问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, c…
items.why_zh: 把自然语言到操作的转换下沉到设备端，有望显著降低延迟与云端依赖，是智能体落地的关键工程问题。
items.why_en: Moving NL-to-action generation on-device could cut latency and cloud dependence, a key engineering issue for deploying agents.

items.title_zh: 用可穿戴活动记录与睡眠轨迹的时序图学习建模青少年晶体智力
items.title_en: Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 可穿戴活动记录提供了一种可扩展、生态效度更高的替代方案，可弥补零散的临床评估。但从这类数据预测青少年连续晶体智力（Gc）仍有难度，原因包括设备佩戴不规律以及行为与环境之间的复杂交互。作者使用美国青少年脑认知发展研究（ABCD Study，Release 5.1）中 6,091 名青少年为期 21 天的 Fitbit 每日汇总数据，并提出 SATURN——睡眠-活动时序统一回归网络——来表征这些轨迹。该工作探索了用被动传感数据评估认知能力的可行性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents…
items.why_zh: 若能由可穿戴数据推断认知指标，将为大规模、低成本的青少年认知发展研究提供新路径。
items.why_en: If cognition can be inferred from wearables, it opens a scalable, low-cost route for studying adolescent cognitive development.

items.title_zh: 用户离开之后，自主深度研究过程中发生了什么？
items.title_en: What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?
items.summary_zh: 在自主深度研究中，用户提供任务与相关背景后便离开，由智能体在没有人工干预的情况下进行长时间调查。该论文研究用户最初提供的信息如何体现在中间行动中，以及这些行动与最终建议之间的关系。作者提出 DRaligned，一个构建在 PDR-Bench 之上的反事实行为评估框架：通过改变某一个与任务相关的用户因素而保持其余上下文不变，来对比信息获取请求、工作草稿与最终报告。这有助于揭示智能体是否真正遵循了用户给出的背景约束。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports.…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一种诊断方法，检验自主研究智能体是否真正把用户背景转化为行动，而非事后附会。
items.why_en: It offers a diagnostic for whether autonomous research agents actually act on user context rather than merely echoing it in the final report.

items.title_zh: SpecRead：衡量语言模型是否真正理解硬件规格的基准
items.title_en: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
items.summary_zh: 现有面向硬件设计的大模型基准，评估的往往是生成产物，如 RTL 代码、断言或测试平台。当模型在这些基准上失败时，失败原因并不明确：可能是误读了规格说明，也可能是理解了规格却写不出代码。为此作者提出 SpecRead，一个把“规格理解”与“生成能力”隔离开来评测的基准。SpecRead v2.1 包含 385 道题，覆盖 10 个开源 OpenTitan IP 模块，涉及精确检索、跨章节推理等内容。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, con…
items.why_zh: 把规格理解从代码生成中拆出来评测，能更准确地定位 LLM 在硬件设计流程中的真实短板。
items.why_en: Separating spec comprehension from code generation pinpoints where LLMs actually fail in hardware design workflows.

items.title_zh: Evo2Team：进化出的技能何时能真正迁移？从筛选到落地
items.title_en: Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究多智能体系统中的“技能迁移”问题：一个技能库能帮助某个多智能体系统，却可能对另一个系统毫无影响；被迁移的规则只有在目标智能体成功执行时才有用。作者以路由与通信技能为对象，在 Count-Frequency 和 AgentsNet 两个任务上，使用 4 至 32 个智能体组成的团队，以及 GPT 和 Qwen 系列不同层级的模型进行实验。结果显示，在 16 种设置中有 14 种能够同时满足质量、成本、模型层级与确认这几个联合目标。随后他们评估了 Evo2Team——一个面向目标团队进行技能筛选、适配与确认的方法，并将其与六种冻结式选择器在 28 个任务设置上进行比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 t…
items.why_zh: 它把“技能能否迁移”从模糊直觉变成可测量的部署问题，为多智能体系统的技能复用提供了评估框架。
items.why_en: It turns the vague question of skill transfer into a measurable deployment problem, offering a framework for reusing skills across multi-agent systems.

items.title_zh: RAGWarrant：在质量、成本、时延与风险约束下为 RAG 策略上线提供证据留存的治理框架
items.title_en: RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常配备大量指标、基准、链路追踪和自动评审工具，但这些工具并不能判断某项策略变更是否安全可发布。为此，作者提出 RAGWarrant，一个开源的“晋升控制”框架，把部署视为受约束的证据决策，而非排行榜选优。该框架对评估器输出与运行遥测进行归一化，施加预先声明的质量与硬性风险门限，为不同证据等级设定可主张的上限，并保留负面结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and…
items.why_zh: 它为 RAG 系统的策略上线提供了可审计、抗风险偏好的发布标准，弥补了“有指标却无法决策”的治理空白。
items.why_en: It supplies an auditable, risk-aware release standard for RAG policy changes, filling the governance gap between having metrics and making deployment decisions.

items.title_zh: JRDB-AVR：面向真实环境具身智能体的主动视觉推理基准
items.title_en: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
items.summary_zh: 在复杂的具身视觉推理场景中，智能体往往只有有限的视野，回答问题所需的证据可能分布在不同的时间、视角和交互对象上。这导致模型可能在没有真正观察到相关对象、时刻或视角的情况下给出看似合理的答案。现有的视觉推理基准大多只评估被动观测和最终答案，忽略了需要主动推理与主动获取证据的情形。为此，作者提出 JRDB-AVR，一个面向真实环境的主动视觉推理基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35032v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from ex…
items.why_zh: 它把评测重点从“答案对不对”转向“证据是否真的被获取”，更贴近具身智能在现实中的推理条件。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from answer correctness to whether evidence was actually acquired, better reflecting how embodied agents must reason in the real world.

items.title_zh: Sol-H3：面向 MiniMax-H3 推理加速的递归自我改进，覆盖云端与边缘的 Sol-Engine
items.title_en: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
items.summary_zh: 视频扩散模型规模迅速扩张，生成能力不断增强，其中 MiniMax-H3 是一个能力强、达到生产级水平的开源模型。但其 330 亿参数与多步迭代去噪过程带来巨大的计算开销：在 NVIDIA GB200 等云端部署中受生成时延制约，在 DGX-Spark 等边缘设备上还面临严格的内存限制，实际生产落地因此受阻。该工作提出 Sol-H3，通过递归自我改进的方式在 Sol-Engine 上加速 MiniMax-H3 的推理，并同时覆盖云端与边缘场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address…
items.why_zh: 它直指大参数视频扩散模型在生产部署中的时延与内存瓶颈，是生成式视频走向实用化的关键一环。
items.why_en: It targets the latency and memory bottlenecks that block production deployment of large video diffusion models, a key step toward practical generative video.

items.title_zh: FinAutoRubric：面向金融研究智能体评测的专家引导自动评分标准生成
items.title_en: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
items.summary_zh: 评估金融研究智能体需要能够体现专家标准、并把取值固定在某一信息截止时点的评分标准。由专家逐条审阅的金融基准依赖固定的逐项评分标准，扩展成本高，且无法编码每家机构自身的标准。FinAutoRubric 让专家给出可复用的评估指引，再由智能体和代码完成针对具体问题的评分标准生成、复核与验证。专家指引以提示词和代码可执行的规则两种形式约束每一个智能体，同时维护一个可复用的任务库。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable…
items.why_zh: 它把昂贵的一次性专家标注转化为可复用的评估指引，让金融智能体评测更可扩展、也更贴合机构自身标准。
items.why_en: It converts costly one-off expert annotation into reusable evaluation guidance, making finance agent evaluation more scalable and institution-specific.

items.title_zh: 面向开源游戏发布事故预测的类型化时序交互特征与仿真支撑方法
items.title_en: Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents
items.summary_zh: 开源电子游戏的质量取决于代码、美术资源、配置、测试、贡献者与问题工作流之间的相互作用，但传统的缺陷预测方法往往会把这些关系抹平或直接忽略。该研究探索在发布层面预测三十天内出现的质量事故，使用 GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot——一个带风险估计校准与工作量感知排序的类型化时序特征流水线。由于可获取的 OS-SGameBench 材料并未提供经人工审核的发布日期与事故标签，论文中的评估是在仿真条件下执行的。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31647v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is…
items.why_zh: 它用类型化时序交互特征刻画游戏项目的复杂依赖关系，为开源项目发布风险管理提供了更贴近真实结构的预测思路。
items.why_en: It models complex project interdependencies with typed temporal features, offering a structurally faithful approach to release-risk forecasting in open-source projects.

items.title_zh: 方言越狱的成因是什么？对表层形式、文化框架与策略库的消融研究
items.title_en: What Drives Dialectal Jailbreaks? An Ablation of Surface Form, Cultural Framing, and Strategy Banks
items.summary_zh: 已有研究表明，生僻的语言变体可能削弱大语言模型的拒答行为，与黑盒提示优化结合时尤为明显。但失败究竟源自非标准表层形式、植根文化的表述框架，还是对表达性提示策略空间的优化，尚不清楚。作者通过把古汉语红队测试框架扩展到上海话和粤语来研究中文语域，并在表层形式、策略库变体与两个目标模型上进行了 36 组消融实验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31664v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work suggests that obscure language registers can weaken large language model refusal behavior, especially when paired with black-box prompt optimization. It remains unclear whether failures stem from non-standard surface form, culturally grounded framing, or optimization over an expressive prompt-strategy space. We study Chinese registers by extending a classical-Chinese red-teaming framework to Shanghainese and Cantonese and running a 36-cell ablation across surface forms, strategy-bank variants, and two target models. The main finding…
items.why_zh: 它拆解了方言越狱的归因问题，帮助区分是语言形式本身还是优化策略导致了模型安全防线失效。
items.why_en: It disentangles the causes of dialectal jailbreaks, clarifying whether linguistic form or optimization strategy is responsible for safety failures.

items.title_zh: 外科基础模型揭示标签效率因任务而异
items.title_en: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
items.summary_zh: 由于专家标注成本高且稀缺，开发标签高效模型是外科 AI 的核心挑战。自监督基础模型能用极少数据适应新任务，但标签效率在不同外科任务之间如何变化，此前基本未被探究。作者提出 SURGE，一个在 SurgSpectrum-30M+ 上训练的外科基础模型，该数据集包含超过 3000 万帧，是目前规模最大的预训练数据集，相关检查点已公开以支持后续研究。研究团队据此系统评估了不同任务下的标签效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency ac…
items.why_zh: 它首次系统揭示外科基础模型的标签效率随任务变化，为有限标注预算下的任务选型与部署提供依据。
items.why_en: It systematically shows that label efficiency in surgical foundation models varies by task, informing task selection and deployment under limited annotation budgets.

items.title_zh: 乳腺X线与乳腺超声报告临床发现提取：专家与人工智能对比
items.title_en: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 乳腺癌是巴西女性癌症相关死亡的首要原因，而从检查申请到报告发布之间的时间直接影响女性对筛查的依从性，因此快速处理这些报告对早期诊断至关重要。本研究正是在这一背景下，比较大型语言模型（LLM）与一支健康研究者团队在识别巴西葡萄牙语乳腺X线和乳腺超声报告中临床发现时的表现，即对比人工智能自动提取与人工提取的效能。研究聚焦于报告结构化信息抽取这一实际环节，旨在评估LLM能否胜任原本由专业人员完成的临床发现识别工作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31974v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Nam…
items.why_zh: 若LLM能可靠地从报告中提取临床发现，就有望缩短报告周转时间、提升筛查依从性与早期诊断效率。
items.why_en: If LLMs can reliably extract clinical findings from reports, they could shorten reporting turnaround and improve screening adherence and early diagnosis.

items.title_zh: 类型化决策模型：早期证据审计与评估清单
items.title_en: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
items.summary_zh: 类型化决策模型（TDM）不生成文本，而是针对调用者定义的选项返回概率分布。TypeSafe于2026年9月15日发布了商用类型化决策模型Jev，随后数天内便出现了一批评估与复现研究。作者回顾了9月19日至24日期间发布的28篇论文，并将其发现与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准以及模型级联等更早的工作联系起来。作者指出，在这一早期文献中，类型化读出本身尚未显示出独立优势，并据此提出评估清单以规范后续研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent a…
items.why_zh: 它为新近商业化的建模范式提供早期证据梳理与评估框架，提醒业界关注实际增益而非概念包装。
items.why_en: It offers an early evidence audit and evaluation checklist for a newly commercialized modeling paradigm, urging attention to real gains rather than framing.

items.title_zh: 训练数据不完整下的主动特征获取
items.title_en: Active Feature Acquisition With Incomplete Training Data
items.summary_zh: 在许多预测任务中，获取全部特征的成本高得难以承受，甚至根本无法获得；同时，固定的特征子集也往往不足以在所有样本上都取得足够好的效果。主动特征获取（AFA）通过在顺序选择特征的过程中权衡特征成本与预测性能来应对这些问题。然而，此前的AFA研究大多假设可以访问完整的训练数据，这一假设在实践中经常被违反。本文研究训练数据不完整情形下的主动特征获取问题，试图在缺失训练数据的现实条件下重新审视特征获取策略。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32325v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In many prediction tasks, acquiring all features can be a prohibitively expensive or outright impossible task. Further, in many cases a static subset of features may not be enough to solve the problem sufficiently across various instances. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses these problems by formalizing the trade-off between feature cost and predictive performance during sequential feature selection. However, prior AFA work largely assumes access to complete training data, an assumption that is often violated in practice. Here we study…
items.why_zh: 放宽“训练数据完整”这一常被违反的假设，让主动特征获取更贴近医疗、传感等真实缺失数据场景。
items.why_en: It relaxes the often-violated assumption of complete training data, making active feature acquisition more realistic for medical and sensor settings with missing data.

items.title_zh: SoFT：面向可泛化LLM微调的软目标
items.title_en: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 蒸馏能让学生语言模型从专家教师处获得新能力，但要把多教师、多领域的示范知识整合进单一学生模型仍然困难。本文研究这一设定下的监督微调（SFT）：学生既要习得多样化的能力，又要在训练任务之外保持泛化。实验显示，不同SFT方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在各不相同的权衡，这促使研究者希望对训练信号施加更显式的控制，并提出软目标（Soft Targets）方法SoFT以改善微调的可泛化性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32493v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control ov…
items.why_zh: 在多教师蒸馏中同时兼顾能力获取与分布外泛化，是当前LLM后训练的关键难题。
items.why_en: Balancing capability acquisition and out-of-distribution generalization in multi-teacher distillation is a key challenge in LLM post-training.

items.title_zh: 检索到了却没送达：长期智能体的多模态记忆投递
items.title_en: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
items.summary_zh: 多模态智能体的记忆研究通常关注记忆写了什么、如何更新以及如何检索，但在检索与最终作答之间还存在一个评估环节尚未单独考察的步骤——“投递”（delivery）：检索到的记忆中有多少、以何种形式真正到达模型。作者在MemLens上进行受控分解实验，发现剩余改进空间正位于此处：在检索到的证据集完全固定的前提下，直接把原始像素投递给模型而非省略，可使8B规模主干模型的准确率提升13.87个百分点，说明瓶颈未必在检索环节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on th…
items.why_zh: 它指出长期记忆系统的瓶颈可能在“投递”而非检索，为多模态智能体记忆设计提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It suggests the bottleneck in long-term memory may lie in delivery rather than retrieval, pointing to a new direction for multimodal agent memory design.

items.title_zh: REALIS：用于研究AI图像检测难题的精选数据集
items.title_en: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
items.summary_zh: AI生成图像检测器往往在真实图像与合成图像于内容、质量或生成痕迹上存在差异的基准上评测，这让模型可能依赖数据集特有的线索，从而在面对陌生生成器或经过处理的图像时失效；现有数据集也难以跨多样视觉内容联合评估这些挑战。为此，作者提出REALIS数据集，包含143万张真实与合成图像，由42个现代文生图模型生成，其中涵盖Nano Banana 2等最新专有系统，旨在更严格地检验检测器的泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32734v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REA…
items.why_zh: 它提供规模更大、更难“走捷径”的评测基准，推动检测器真正泛化到未见过的生成模型。
items.why_en: It provides a larger benchmark that is harder to game, pushing detectors toward genuine generalization to unseen generative models.

items.title_zh: 多模态LLM在跨域组织学相似度上优于病理基础模型
items.title_en: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
items.summary_zh: 当前最先进的病理基础模型在数百万张组织学切片上训练，但当比较跨越不同切片或不同机构时，它们可能无法保持组织相似性。本研究发现，未经病理基础模型专门训练的通用多模态大语言模型，在跨域组织学相似度判断上反而持续优于这些专用模型。作者提出一种相对相似度框架，并以MOSAIC（跨机构与队列的模型相似度评估）基准发布，对17个模型进行了评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了“领域专用基础模型必然更优”的假设，凸显通用多模态模型在医学跨域任务中的潜力与评测方式的重要性。
items.why_en: It challenges the assumption that domain-specific foundation models are always better, highlighting the potential of general multimodal models in cross-domain medical tasks.

items.title_zh: 数据包级数字硬件孪生：为托卡马克兆赫级诊断边缘AI与等离子体控制集成调试
items.title_en: A packet-level digital hardware twin for commissioning megahertz diagnostic edge AI and plasma control system integration in tokamaks
items.summary_zh: 高带宽等离子体诊断正越来越多地为面向实时托卡马克控制的机器学习与信号处理算法提供输入，但由于采样率极高，从诊断采样到控制系统交接的完整链路很难调试。为此，研究者开发了一个数据包级数字硬件孪生仿真器，用于兆赫级诊断边缘AI架构：它模拟嵌入96通道双载波采集系统中的64通道、1 MHz波束发射光谱（BES）诊断，以及两个48通道子系统，从而在真实硬件部署前对整条链路进行验证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-bandwidth plasma diagnostics increasingly provide inputs to machine learning and signal-processing algorithms intended for real-time tokamak control, but the complete path from diagnostic sampling to control-system handoff is difficult to commission because of their sampling rates. We develop a packet-level digital hardware twin for the megahertz diagnostic edge-AI architecture. The simulator represents a 64-channel, 1 MHz beam emission spectroscopy (BES) diagnostic embedded in a 96-channel dual-carrier acquisition system, two 48-channel s…
items.why_zh: 它为聚变装置中高采样率诊断与实时AI控制链路的联合调试提供了可仿真的验证途径，有助于降低实际部署风险。
items.why_en: It offers a simulatable way to commission high-rate diagnostics and real-time AI control paths in fusion devices, reducing deployment risk.

items.title_zh: 学会引导，引导以见：用可训练向量揭示大语言模型中 RLVR 的几何结构
items.title_en: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
items.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）——当前提升大语言模型推理能力的关键范式，但参数更新的高维性使训练动态难以分析。作者采用向量引导（vector steering）方法，在激活空间中识别出与 RL 带来性能增益相关的低维有效流形。他们揭示了两项几何性质，其中“有效流形容量”表明复现 RL 收益所需的容量可以非常小，但并非可以无限压缩。这项工作为理解 RL 训练的内在机制提供了可解释的几何视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34344v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compre…
items.why_zh: 把 LLM 强化学习的效果归结为低维几何结构，有望让原本难以分析的 RL 训练动态变得可测量、可干预。
items.why_en: Framing LLM reinforcement learning gains as low-dimensional geometry could make otherwise intractable RL training dynamics measurable and steerable.

items.title_zh: 面向变带宽下鲁棒多智能体通信的注意力分层变分信息瓶颈
items.title_en: Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth
items.summary_zh: 在带宽受限条件下进行基于学习的多智能体通信，不仅要决定“说什么”，还要组织消息结构，使部分传输仍然可用。作者研究前缀截断（prefix truncation）场景，即接收方只能收到每条消息的前一部分。为此提出 AH-VIB：一种基于注意力的自回归变分通信模型，将变分信息瓶颈（VIB）与序列化消息生成、分层鲁棒性损失相结合。模型旨在提升消息在仅被部分接收时的稳健性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34860v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB…
items.why_zh: 让消息在被截断时仍保持有用，是带宽受限多智能体系统走向实用部署的关键一环。
items.why_en: Keeping messages useful even when truncated is key to making bandwidth-limited multi-agent systems practical.

items.title_zh: 空间嫁接：为流匹配机器人策略锚定三维特征
items.title_en: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
items.summary_zh: 预训练的机器人操作策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）与世界动作模型（WAM），往往把与交互相关的度量几何信息留在隐含表示中。空间重建领域的最新突破能够可靠提供所需几何，但其特征只描述局部形状，并不说明该形状相对机器人的位置。为解决“如何把这些特征交给预训练策略”这一悬而未决的问题，作者提出 Spatial Grafting：一个轻量通用的空间模块，将冻结的重建特征绑定到度量几何上，供流匹配策略使用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35249v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to met…
items.why_zh: 把可靠的三维几何注入预训练机器人策略，有望在不重训大模型的前提下提升操作精度。
items.why_en: Injecting reliable 3D geometry into pretrained robot policies could improve manipulation accuracy without retraining large models.

items.title_zh: eval-unlearn：为文生图扩散模型的概念遗忘建立基准
items.title_en: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
items.summary_zh: 随着文生图（T2I）扩散模型的概念遗忘技术不断增多，评估环境却日益碎片化：各方法在互不相同的实验条件下被检验，导致难以进行有原则的横向比较。作者提出 eval-unlearn，一个开源 Python 库，为 T2I 扩散模型中的概念遗忘提供统一、可复现的基准测试框架。该库整合了 12 种已发表的遗忘技术，覆盖微调、闭式模型编辑与推理时干预等类别。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time i…
items.why_zh: 统一的遗忘评测基准让不同方法可被公平比较，是判断模型能否真正“忘记”目标概念的前提。
items.why_en: A unified unlearning benchmark enables fair comparison across methods, a prerequisite for verifying that models truly forget targeted concepts.

items.title_zh: 用大语言模型自动识别跨领域机器学习任务类型：基准数据集与评估
items.title_en: Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 机器学习任务类型识别是构建有效 ML 流程的必要环节，但实践中通常由人工指定。作者研究大语言模型（LLM）能否在用户仅提供目标特征的情况下，直接从数据集层面的信息推断数据领域与下游预测任务。除基于 LLM 的系统外，他们还发布了一个包含 625 个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准。论文在多种设定（包括表格数据）下对该方法进行了评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular…
items.why_zh: 若 LLM 能自动判断任务类型与数据领域，将显著降低构建机器学习流程的人工负担与专业门槛。
items.why_en: If LLMs can infer task type and domain automatically, building ML pipelines becomes far less manual and expertise-dependent.

items.title_zh: AwarenessBench：评估语言模型的认知能力
items.title_en: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
items.summary_zh: 随着语言模型表现出越来越多类似意识的行为，评估其认知能力变得愈发必要。作者提出 AwarenessBench，称其为首个从四个维度综合评价语言模型认知能力的基准：元认知、自我意识、社会意识与情境意识，覆盖 15 项认知功能、共 14,381 个样本。对 18 个最先进语言模型的评测显示，它们均持续优于随机基线，且更先进的模型表现更好。论文还进一步将语言模型与其他对象进行了对比。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35409v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs wi…
items.why_zh: 为“类意识”行为提供可量化的评测维度，有助于把关于模型认知能力的讨论从直觉转向证据。
items.why_en: Quantifiable dimensions for consciousness-like behavior move the debate about model cognition from intuition toward evidence.

items.title_zh: 更少谄媚，更强拒答？来自机制可解释性的 AI 安全启示
items.title_en: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
items.summary_zh: 对有害请求的可靠拒答是语言模型安全部署的核心，而过度迎合用户可能削弱已有的拒答能力，因此减少谄媚行为或可成为超越安全训练覆盖场景、进一步强化拒答的一条路径。作者使用补偿性特征注入（CFI）——一种在学习过程中提供目标概念相关激活、以限制该概念获取的训练技术——在三个 Qwen3.5 基础模型上展开研究。该工作借助机制可解释性视角，探讨谄媚与拒答之间的关联。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35544v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we us…
items.why_zh: 揭示谄媚与拒答之间的机制联系，为无需额外安全微调即可提升模型安全性提供了可能路径。
items.why_en: Linking sycophancy and refusal mechanistically points to safety gains that do not rely on additional safety fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: 蒸馏防御在强化学习之后轻易失效
items.title_en: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 蒸馏攻击通过大量收集前沿模型的推理轨迹并训练自有模型，以低成本复制闭源大模型的推理能力。现有防御通常在蒸馏刚结束时进行评估，隐含假设攻击者不会继续训练其模型。作者认为更现实的威胁模型应把后续训练纳入考虑，并指出蒸馏防御在强化学习之后容易被突破。该研究对当前防御评估方式的有效性提出了质疑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35699v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model i…
items.why_zh: 若攻击者只需再做一轮强化学习就能绕过防御，当前基于蒸馏即时评估得出的安全结论就难以成立。
items.why_en: If one round of reinforcement learning suffices to bypass defenses, safety conclusions drawn from immediate post-distillation evaluation no longer hold.

items.title_zh: MonitorBench：面向大语言模型思维链可监控性的综合基准
items.title_en: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型生成的思维链（CoT）并不总是其最终输出的真实因果依据。当思维链与实际驱动模型行为的决策关键因素不一致时，思维链便不再忠实反映模型的真实推理过程，从而出现“可监控性下降”的问题，这限制了将思维链用于可靠监督的可能。然而，目前仍缺乏一个全面且完全开源的基准来系统评估思维链的可监控性。为此，作者提出 MonitorBench，旨在填补这一评测空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.28590v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate chains of thought (CoTs) that are not always causally responsible for their final outputs. When such a mismatch occurs, the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the actual reasons (i.e., decision-critical factors) driving the model's behavior, leading to the reduced CoT monitorability problem. This limits the use of CoTs for reliable oversight. However, a comprehensive and fully open-source benchmark for thoroughly evaluating CoT monitorability remains lacking. To address this gap, we propose MonitorBenc…
items.why_zh: 思维链能否忠实反映模型真实决策依据，直接决定基于思维链的监督与安全审计是否可靠。
items.why_en: Whether CoTs faithfully reflect a model's actual decision factors determines whether CoT-based oversight and safety auditing can be trusted.

items.title_zh: LLM 智能体的最优技能选择：具备可证明双准则保证
items.title_en: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
items.summary_zh: 将可复用的技能文档载入有限的上下文窗口，已成为大语言模型智能体获取任务专属能力的主要方式，因此技能选择成为决定任务表现与 token 成本的关键因素。然而现有智能体通常独立地按语义相关性给技能打分，再用 top-k 或贪心打包的方式组合技能集合，既没有质量保证，也不考虑成本。冗余或选择不当的技能会浪费稀缺的上下文 token，甚至导致性能下降。本文针对该问题提出具备可证明双准则保证的技能选择方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19993v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window has become a primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. Redundant or poorly chosen skills then waste scarce context tokens and can even degrade performance. In this paper,…
items.why_zh: 在上下文窗口有限的前提下，技能选择直接决定智能体的效果与推理成本，缺乏保证的启发式方法存在明显风险。
items.why_en: With limited context windows, skill selection directly determines agent effectiveness and inference cost, making unguaranteed heuristics risky.

items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在国际海运危险货物规则（IMDG）合规中的表现
items.title_en: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance
items.summary_zh: 海运危险货物是高风险活动，受《国际海运危险货物规则》（IMDG Code）这一复杂监管框架约束，分类、包装、积载或隔离方面的错误可能导致火灾、爆炸、有毒物质泄漏乃至人员伤亡或船舶损失。要做到合规，必须准确理解数百页相互关联的条款，而该规则每两年修订一次。实务人员正越来越多地把大语言模型当作决策支持工具使用，但目前尚缺乏系统性的评估。本文针对大语言模型在 IMDG 合规场景下的表现开展评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21036v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The transport of dangerous goods by sea is a high-consequence activity governed by the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, a complex regulatory framework where errors in classification, packaging, stowage, or segregation can result in fire, explosion, toxic release, or loss of life or vessel. Correct compliance requires accurately interpreting hundreds of pages of interacting provisions, updated on a two-year amendment cycle. Practitioners increasingly use Large Language Models (LLMs) as decision-support tools, yet no systemat…
items.why_zh: 危险货物合规错误后果极为严重，在缺乏系统评测的情况下将 LLM 用于合规决策存在显著安全与监管风险。
items.why_en: Compliance errors in dangerous goods transport can be catastrophic, so deploying LLMs as decision support without systematic evaluation poses serious safety and regulatory risk.

items.title_zh: LocalLSTC：面向本地部署 GUI 智能体的长短期控制架构
items.title_en: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
items.summary_zh: 当前 GUI 智能体框架借助前沿 API 模型在桌面任务上表现优异，但持续性的控制信息往往隐含在不断增长的交互轨迹中。每一步，规划器都需要重新构建当前任务阶段、已积累的证据与运行时反馈，才能决定下一个动作。当本地推理骨干较弱时，这种依赖会更为突出：在四个代表性前沿框架上，将 GPT-5 替换为 Qwen3.5-9B 后，OSWorld SR-100 平均从 60.9% 降至 35.2%。本文提出 LocalLSTC，用长短期控制架构缓解该问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.25777v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern GUI-agent frameworks achieve strong desktop task performance with frontier API models, yet persistent control information often remains implicit in growing interaction trajectories. At each step, the planner reconstructs the active task stage, accumulated evidence, and runtime feedback before deciding the next action. This dependence becomes more pronounced under weaker local reasoning backbones. Across four representative state-of-the-art frameworks, replacing GPT-5 with Qwen3.5-9B reduces average OSWorld SR-100 from 60.9\% to 35.2\%.…
items.why_zh: 在本地部署与弱模型条件下性能大幅下滑，凸显了显式维护控制状态对 GUI 智能体落地的关键作用。
items.why_en: The large performance drop under local, weaker backbones highlights how critical explicit control-state maintenance is for deployable GUI agents.

items.title_zh: AquiLLM：评估开放权重 RAG-LLM 系统在科研场景中的忠实性
items.title_en: AquiLLM: Evaluating Faithfulness in Open-Weight RAG-LLM Systems for Scientific Research
items.summary_zh: 科学研究日益依赖规模庞大且异构的数据源，这推动了检索增强生成（RAG）系统的关注，使其为科学知识与研究工作流提供自然语言入口。研究者正在探索将这类系统用作文档检索，以及生成分析代码与流水线组件的自然语言界面。与此同时，对数据隐私与研究基础设施控制权的担忧，也促使人们关注开放权重模型与开源解决方案。本文提出 AquiLLM，用于评估开放权重 RAG-LLM 系统在科研场景中的忠实性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16519v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scientific research increasingly relies on large, heterogeneous data sources, motivating interest in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that provide natural language access to scientific knowledge and research workflows. Researchers are exploring the viability of these systems as natural language interfaces for document search and for generating analysis code and pipeline components. At the same time, concerns about data privacy and control over research infrastructure have motivated interest in open-weight models and open-source de…
items.why_zh: 若科研用 RAG 系统输出不忠实于来源文献，可能误导研究结论与代码生成，因此忠实性评测是可信科研工具的前提。
items.why_en: If research RAG systems are unfaithful to their sources, they can mislead conclusions and generated code, making faithfulness evaluation a prerequisite for trustworthy scientific tooling.

items.title_zh: 下一步该问什么？面向交互式 ReID 的检索感知问题学习
items.title_en: What Should We Ask Next? Retrieval-Aware Question Learning for Interactive ReID
items.summary_zh: 在仅有部分证据的交互式检索中，智能体面临的是一个序贯信息获取问题：它必须选择能够为下一次检索更新带来有用证据的问题。现有系统通过模仿候选问答对的离线排序来训练这一决策，但一个问题的价值取决于它引出的回答，以及该回答对后续检索的下游影响。作者指出，候选问题的区分度与感知有用性只能为该目标提供较弱的监督信号，并据此提出检索感知方法 RAVEL。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21924v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interactive retrieval with partial evidence constitutes a sequential information-acquisition problem: an agent must choose questions that acquire useful evidence for the next retrieval update. Existing systems train this decision by imitating an offline ordering of candidate QA pairs. However, a question's value depends on the response it elicits and its downstream effect on retrieval. We establish that candidate discriminativeness and perceived usefulness provide weak supervision for this objective, then introduce RAVEL, a retrieval-aware on…
items.why_zh: 交互式检索的效果取决于提问策略，用离线模仿替代真实检索反馈会限制系统性能，检索感知学习提供了更贴近目标的训练方式。
items.why_en: Interactive retrieval hinges on question-asking strategy; imitating offline orderings instead of real retrieval feedback limits performance, so retrieval-aware learning targets the objective more directly.

items.title_zh: LLM 竞标者保留了人类竞标者在机制层面的排序
items.title_en: LLM Bidders Preserve the Mechanism-Level Orderings of Human Bidders
items.summary_zh: 由于大语言模型在海量人类生成数据上训练，用其模拟人类行为的研究兴趣不断上升。本文关注的是：在竞标者依据明确规则与激励相互作用的拍卖场景中，通用模型在开箱即用的情况下能保留人类行为的哪些特征。研究评估了五种大语言模型在七种实验室拍卖设定中的表现，并与从已发表实验中重建的人类基准进行对比，同时对私人价值比较给出了不确定性区间。分析重点集中在三个大型……（摘要原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.09083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training on vast amounts of human-generated data has motivated growing interest in using large language models (LLMs) to simulate human behavior. We ask which features of human behavior general-purpose models preserve when used out of the box in auctions, where multiple bidders interact under explicit rules and incentives. We evaluate five LLMs across seven laboratory settings against human benchmarks reconstructed from published experiments, with uncertainty bands for the private-value comparisons. Our main focus is on three large mode…
items.why_zh: 若 LLM 能复现人类在拍卖中的机制层面行为排序，就可用于市场机制设计与政策实验的模拟；但若仅表面相似，则模拟结论会失真。
items.why_en: If LLMs reproduce the mechanism-level orderings of human bidding behavior, they can be used to simulate market design and policy experiments; if the similarity is only superficial, simulation-based conclusions will be misleading.

items.title_zh: 用平展映射扩展视觉 Transformer 以处理功能磁共振成像
items.title_en: Scaling Vision Transformers for Functional MRI with Flat Maps
items.summary_zh: 本文研究为功能磁共振成像（fMRI）训练自监督基础模型的问题。作者的主要贡献有两项：一是提出新的模型家族 CortexMAE，在 2.1K 小时的公开 fMRI 数据上采用掩码自编码器框架进行训练；二是发布首个面向 fMRI 基础模型的公开评测套件 Brainmarks。其核心创新很简单：先把每个三维 fMRI 体数据通过皮层平展映射转换为二维图，从而让 Vision Transformer 适配 fMRI，并将平展映射与分区（parcellation）等表示方式直接进行比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.13768v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the problem of training self-supervised foundation models for functional MRI. Our main contributions are: (1) we introduce a new model family (CortexMAE) trained using the masked autoencoder framework on 2.1K hours of open fMRI data, and (2) we release the first open evaluation suite (Brainmarks) for fMRI foundation models. Our core innovation is simple: we adapt the Vision Transformer to fMRI by first converting each 3D fMRI volume to a 2D map using a cortical flat map projection. We directly compare flat maps to both parcella…
items.why_zh: 为 fMRI 提供开源基础模型与标准化评测基准，有望推动神经影像领域的自监督学习与可复现比较。
items.why_en: Open foundation models plus a standardized benchmark for fMRI can advance self-supervised learning and reproducible comparison in neuroimaging.

items.title_zh: 每帧一个 Token：重新审视 VLA 世界模型中的视觉带宽
items.title_en: One Token Per Frame: Reconsidering Visual Bandwidth in World Models for VLA Policy
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以借助视觉预测来预判未来状态，但稠密的视觉特征会让生成序列随相机视角数量、预测时域和编码器分辨率的增加而膨胀。该论文提出 OneWM-VLA，对每个保留的相机视角，仅在每个未来时间步用一个预测 token 来表示，并通过自适应注意力池化（Adaptive Attention Pooling）把视觉特征压缩为紧凑潜变量，这些潜变量与机器人动作联合生成。研究追问的核心问题是：对有效控制而言，稠密的视觉表示是否真的必要。（原摘要在此处被截断，未见具体实验数据。）
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.07931v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can use visual prediction to anticipate future states, but dense visual features make the generative sequence grow with the number of camera views, prediction horizon, and encoder resolution. Whether such dense representations are necessary for effective control remains unclear. We introduce OneWM-VLA, which represents each retained camera view with one predictive token per future step. Adaptive Attention Pooling compresses visual features into compact latents, which are jointly generated with robot a…
items.why_zh: 若能以极低的视觉 token 带宽支撑控制，将大幅降低 VLA 世界模型的计算与存储开销。
items.why_en: If control can work with far lower visual token bandwidth, it could sharply cut the compute and memory cost of VLA world models.

items.title_zh: 告别 K-means：面向高效多向量检索的单阶段稀疏编码
items.title_en: No More K-means: Single-Stage Sparse Coding for Efficient Multi-Vector Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 以 ColBERT 为代表的多向量检索（MVR）模型通过保留细粒度的 token 级交互，刷新了检索精度纪录，但这种粒度也带来难以承受的存储与检索效率瓶颈。为应对十亿级 token 向量的巨大内存占用与计算开销，当前最先进的系统被迫依赖激进降维与复杂聚类（如 K-means），而这一折衷引入了若干关键限制。该论文提出单阶段稀疏编码方法，试图绕过 K-means 式聚类，实现高效的多向量检索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.30120v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval (MVR) models, exemplified by ColBERT, have established new benchmarks in retrieval accuracy by preserving fine-grained token-level interactions. However, this granularity imposes prohibitive storage and retrieval efficiency bottlenecks: to manage the immense memory footprint and computational overhead of billion-scale token vectors, state-of-the-art systems are forced to rely on aggressive dimension reduction and complex clustering (e.g., K-means). This compromise introduces two critical limitations: excessive ind…
items.why_zh: 在不牺牲 token 级精度的前提下压缩多向量索引，是十亿级检索系统得以落地的关键。
items.why_en: Compressing multi-vector indexes without losing token-level accuracy is key to deploying billion-scale retrieval systems.

items.title_zh: 量化并缓解桃叶病害分类中的域偏移：注意力机制与微调策略
items.title_en: Quantifying and Mitigating Domain Shift in Peach Leaf Damage Classification: Attention Mechanisms and Fine-Tuning Strategies
items.summary_zh: 用于作物损害评估的深度学习模型通常在精心整理的公开图像上训练和验证，但其在真实果园中的表现仍缺乏量化。该工作针对桃叶病害分类衡量并缓解这一落差——气候驱动的非生物与生物胁迫会产生外观相似的叶片症状。作者从公开来源构建了包含 1366 片人工标注桃叶、覆盖六种损害类型的基准，并另外收集了 180 张横跨不同场景的实地图像数据集，进而考察注意力机制与微调策略的作用。原摘要在此处被截断，具体结论未披露。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.02045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning models for crop damage assessment are typically trained and validated on curated public imagery, yet their behaviour when deployed in real orchards remains poorly quantified. This work measures and mitigates that gap for peach leaf damage classification, where climate-driven abiotic and biotic stresses produce visually similar foliar symptoms. A benchmark of 1366 manually annotated peach leaves covering six damage types was assembled from public sources, and a second, independently acquired dataset of 180 field images acro…
items.why_zh: 揭示实验室图像与真实果园之间的性能落差，是农业 AI 可靠部署的前提。
items.why_en: Exposing the gap between curated imagery and real orchards is a prerequisite for reliably deploying agricultural AI.

items.title_zh: LACUNA：评估 LLM 遗忘中定位精度的测试平台
items.title_en: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
items.summary_zh: LLM 会记忆敏感训练数据（包括个人身份信息），因此亟需可靠的事后删除方法。机器遗忘（unlearning）被视为有前景的方案，当前最先进方法多遵循“先定位、后遗忘”的范式，针对特定模型参数下手。然而，现有基准仅在输出层面评估遗忘效果，无法回答一个关键问题：遗忘究竟是从模型参数中真正抹除了知识，还是仅仅把它掩盖起来。LACUNA 正是为评估遗忘方法的定位精度而提出的测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.02513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLMs memorize sensitive training data, including personally identifiable information (PII), creating a pressing need for reliable post hoc removal methods. Unlearning has emerged as a promising solution, with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods often following a localize-first, unlearn-second paradigm that targets specific model parameters. However, existing benchmarks evaluate unlearning solely at the output level, leaving open the question of whether unlearning truly erases knowledge from a model's parameters or merely obfuscates it, a co…
items.why_zh: 只有能验证参数层面的真实擦除，遗忘机制才足以支撑隐私合规。
items.why_en: Only verifiable, parameter-level erasure can make unlearning trustworthy for privacy compliance.

items.title_zh: 超越图结构：自适应元学习器融合可解释性、天气与动力学实现稳健公交到站预测
items.title_en: Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction
items.summary_zh: 准确的公交预计到站时间（ETA）预测对城市出行、乘客满意度与公交效率至关重要，但现有模型难以应对非线性时空动态、数据稀疏以及天气等因素。论文提出 HYB(nm)，一个自适应混合集成框架，动态融合五个互补模型：历史基线（MST-AV）、周期性时序模式分析（GDRN-DFT）、用于非线性动力学的 Koopman 神经算子（KOOP-NET），以及融合天气的特征工程神经网络等。原摘要在此处被截断，具体评估结果未披露。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural n…
items.why_zh: 用元学习集成动力学与天气信号，有望提升复杂城市环境下 ETA 预测的鲁棒性。
items.why_en: Fusing dynamics and weather through meta-learning ensembles could make ETA prediction more robust in complex urban environments.

items.title_zh: 基于超宽带数据的人体活动识别：降维、模式发现与预测建模框架
items.title_en: Human Activity Recognition via Ultra-Wideband Data: A Framework for Dimensionality Reduction, Pattern Discovery, and Predictive Modeling
items.summary_zh: 传感器技术的进步推动了人体活动识别（HAR），尤其是在计算资源受限的实时系统中。然而，超宽带（UWB）雷达数据因高维、噪声大、复杂且具非线性特征而难以处理。该研究提出一个框架，用于高效缩减数据规模、挖掘显著模式，并对六类活动（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk）实现高精度分类，其中包含两种新颖的降维方法。原摘要在此处被截断，具体精度数字尚未给出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in sensor technology have enabled more effective human activity recognition (HAR), particularly in real-time systems with limited computational resources. However, Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar data remain challenging due to high dimensionality, noise, complexity, and nonlinear characteristics. This research proposes a framework to efficiently reduce data size, uncover significant patterns, and classify six activity types (Standff, Liedown, Noactivity, Sit, Stand, and Walk) from UWB signals with high accuracy. Two novel dimensionalit…
items.why_zh: 面向 UWB 雷达的轻量框架有助于在低算力设备上实现实时、非接触式活动识别。
items.why_en: A lightweight UWB radar framework could enable real-time, contactless activity recognition on low-power devices.

items.title_zh: SAMBAR：用乘子法选择性锚定，平衡 VLA 模型的知识获取与保持
items.title_en: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型借助大规模预训练迈向通用操作能力，而部署后的策略必须支持持续学习，随时间不断掌握新任务。教会 VLA 新任务通常需要在其演示数据上微调，但朴素的微调会导致策略遗忘先前任务、损害通用能力，这就是灾难性遗忘。大多数持续学习方法依靠回放早期任务数据来对抗遗忘；SAMBAR 则提出基于乘子法的选择性锚定方案，以在获取新知识与保留旧知识之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks.…
items.why_zh: 让机器人策略在学新任务时不丢失旧技能，是 VLA 走向长期部署的核心难题。
items.why_en: Letting robot policies learn new tasks without losing earlier skills is central to long-term VLA deployment.

items.title_zh: 旧评估何时能为新模型背书？评估器漂移下的标签高效发布决策
items.title_en: When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift
items.summary_zh: 发布模型更新时，必须证明其在当前人群分布下的风险低于阈值。可信标签成本高昂，而廉价评估器（如 LLM 裁判）可以为每个样本打分。复用早期审计中得到的评估器误差信息很诱人，但这种证据何时能替代当前标签，取决于历史的性质：如果误差可能发生不可见的漂移，那么没有任何无标签检验能检测到这种变化，任何有效且有用的认证器都必须按论文刻画的速率持续购买标签；若假定变化有界，则可以实现更省标签的认证方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-f…
items.why_zh: 它明确了评估器漂移下旧证据何时失效，为模型发布的统计保证划出边界。
items.why_en: It delineates when stale evaluator evidence becomes invalid, setting bounds on statistical guarantees for model releases.

items.title_zh: 协同信息何时有助于主动特征获取？一项基于 PID 的研究
items.title_en: When Does Synergy Help Active Feature Acquisition? A PID-Based Study
items.summary_zh: 主动特征获取（AFA）在预算约束下逐步挑选信息量最大的特征，但现有策略很少区分交互特征带来的信息究竟属于冗余、独特还是协同。该论文提出 SynAFA——一种依赖状态的 AFA 策略，把成对联合信息与条件信息结合起来，并用部分信息分解（PID）刻画其信息结构。作者在五个表格数据集和 MNIST-loop 上进行评估，发现性能表现并不一致（原文摘要在此处截断），说明协同信息并非在所有场景下都能带来收益。这项工作为“协同信息在何种条件下对特征获取有益”提供了可分析的信息论框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects informative features under budget constraints. However, existing policies rarely distinguish whether information contributed by interacting features is redundant, unique, or synergistic. We introduce SynAFA, a state-dependent AFA policy that combines pairwise joint information and conditional information, with Partial Information Decomposition (PID) characterizing its information structure. Across five tabular datasets and MNIST-loop, performance is heterogeneous. SynAFA shows its strongest ga…
items.why_zh: 它用部分信息分解厘清“协同信息”的边界，为设计更省预算的特征获取策略提供理论依据。
items.why_en: It uses Partial Information Decomposition to clarify when synergy actually pays off, offering a principled basis for budget-aware feature acquisition policies.

items.title_zh: 神经动力学即量化单元的复合
items.title_en: Neural Dynamics as the Composition of Quantized Units
items.summary_zh: 深度学习通常被放在两个层面理解：宏观层面用缩放定律（scaling laws）概括损失的整体趋势，微观层面则研究神经元、特征与回路。核心难题在于如何把这两个层面连接起来，解释基本计算如何复合、并共同塑造宏观行为。为此，作者研究了一个中间抽象：把训练描述为对“量子”（quanta）的有序获取——这些可复用的计算是突然被习得、并在样本间以二元方式被激活的。该视角试图在宏观缩放规律与微观机制之间架起桥梁。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning is commonly interpreted at two levels: the macroscopic, through aggregate trends in loss summarized by scaling laws, and the microscopic, through neurons, features, and circuits. A central challenge is understanding how these levels connect, so that we can explain how elementary computations compose and collectively shape macroscopic behavior. To this end, we study an intermediate abstraction in which training is described as the ordered acquisition of quanta: reusable computations acquired suddenly and binary-activated across examp…
items.why_zh: 它为衔接宏观缩放规律与微观神经元机制提供了一个可操作的中间层解释框架。
items.why_en: It offers an intermediate-level account that could bridge macroscopic scaling laws and microscopic neural mechanisms.

items.title_zh: 大规模评测脑电基础模型：两万次评估的经验
items.title_en: Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations
items.summary_zh: 脑电（EEG）基础模型被寄望于提供可迁移的神经表征，但它们相对强监督基线的优势、以及继续扩大规模的前景仍不清晰。作者推出开源基准 EEG-Arena，覆盖 30 个 EEG 基础模型与 25 个监督基线，在来自 23 个公开数据集的 57 项下游任务上评测。研究通过五种实验协议、超过两万次评估，系统考察下游性能、预训练收益、模型规模缩放以及预训练相关因素。其结果为基础模型在 EEG 领域的实际效用与扩展潜力提供了迄今规模最大的对照证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining…
items.why_zh: 它以超过两万次评估的规模，检验了脑电基础模型是否真的优于监督基线并值得继续扩大规模。
items.why_en: With more than 20,000 evaluations, it tests whether EEG foundation models truly beat supervised baselines and warrant further scaling.

items.title_zh: 复用还是重学？地球观测基础模型的谱视角
items.title_en: Reuse or Relearn? A Spectral View of Earth Observation Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 基础模型很少被当作通用的冻结特征提取器使用，通常都会针对下游任务进行微调，这一做法在地球观测（EO）领域尤为普遍。但仅凭下游精度无法回答一个关键问题：微调究竟是在复用预训练表征，还是重新学了一套新表征？作者引入谱诊断方法，对比模型在适配前后的状态，量化其主导奇异子空间的保留程度，以及权重更新的波及范围。该分析为判断地球观测基础模型的迁移行为是“复用”还是“重学”提供了新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models are rarely used as generic, frozen feature extractors; instead, they are fine-tuned for the target downstream application. This practice is particularly prevalent in Earth observation (EO), and it raises a question that downstream accuracy alone cannot answer: does fine-tuning reuse the pretrained representation, or does it relearn a new one? We study this with spectral diagnostics that compare a model before and after adaptation, quantifying how well its dominant singular subspaces are preserved, how broadly the weight update i…
items.why_zh: 它提供了量化指标，用以判断微调究竟是复用还是覆盖了预训练表征。
items.why_en: It supplies quantitative diagnostics for whether fine-tuning reuses or overwrites pretrained representations.

items.title_zh: 函数级漏洞评分更多反映评测协议而非模型：配对基准中的协议效应
items.title_en: A Function-Level Vulnerability Score Measures Flag Rate More Than the Model: Protocol Effects on Paired Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 语言模型越来越多地被当作漏洞检测器来评测，但外观相似的模型在不同论文中报告的分数差异很大。作者在固定模型输出的前提下，测量评测协议能解释多少这种差异。在配对测试中，模型需要标出一个存在漏洞的函数，并在修复提交后放行其对应版本。研究逐一改变已发表评测中做法各异的三项选择：度量指标、判定提取方式和输出预算。实验对七个前沿模型与大型开源模型在五组已发布的配对数据上进行了评估，结果显示协议选择本身对分数影响显著。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are increasingly evaluated as vulnerability detectors, and scores reported for similar models differ widely between papers. We measured how much of that difference evaluation protocol accounts for, with model outputs held fixed. In a paired test, a model must flag a vulnerable function and clear its version after a fixing commit. Three choices that published evaluations make differently were varied one at a time: metric, verdict extraction and output budget. Seven frontier and large open models were evaluated on five released pair…
items.why_zh: 它提醒漏洞检测分数在很大程度上由评测协议决定，跨论文比较需格外谨慎。
items.why_en: It shows that vulnerability-detection scores are substantially driven by evaluation protocol, cautioning against cross-paper comparisons.
